meta.author: Śrīla Narottam Dās Ṭhākur
meta.first_line: hari hari! baḍa śela marame rahila

translation: O Lord! O Lord! A huge spear has pierced my heart. I obtained a rare human body but did not serve Śrī Kṛṣṇa. My birth has now passed in vain.

text: muñi se pāmara-mati    viśeṣe kaṭhina ati
translation: Śrī Hari, the prince of Vraja, has descended in Nabadwīp and filled the world with divine love, but I am wicked-minded; I am especially and extremely obstinate, so I did not receive His mercy.

text: divya chintāmaṇi dhāma    vṛndāvana hena sthāna
translation: Svarūp, Sanātan, Rūpa, Raghunāth Dās, Gopāl Bhaṭṭa, and Raghunāth Bhaṭṭa – I have had no attachment to them, and I have never resided in Śrī Vṛndāvan Dhām, the abode of divine, wish-fulfilling gemstones.

text: viśeṣa viṣaye mati    nahila vaiṣṇave rati
narottama dāsa kahe    jībāra uchita nahe
translation: I am completely absorbed in the mundane, and I have no attachment to the Vaiṣṇavas. Thus, I constantly lament. Narottam Dās says, “I have no reason to live without the service of Śrī Guru and the Vaiṣṇavas.”
